name: PLLS
description: The capsules of PLLS given weather: mesh-gradient ground, film-grain skin. The current direction of the work.

cartela.eu:
Kapsula bat ez da forma: bi punturen arteko distantzia bat da, lodiera batekin.
Kolokatzea ez da apaingarria: elkarren gainean zenbat egon daitezkeen erabakitzen du arauak.
cartela.en:
A capsule is not a shape: it is a distance between two points, given a thickness.
Placement is not arrangement: the rule decides how much they may overlap.

name: KRRTK
description: Karratuak. A square deciding, again and again, whether to divide. Recursive subdivision against a threshold — structure as the only ornament. Atmosphere is a setting, not another work: the gradient beneath and the grain above can be lowered to nothing, and the rule is unchanged.

cartela.eu:
Karratu bat, behin eta berriz, zatitu ala ez erabakitzen.
Lauetan zatitzen da, eta laugarrena beti botatzen: hutsune hori da serieak esaten duena.
cartela.en:
A square deciding, again and again, whether to divide.
It splits in four and always discards the fourth: that missing quarter is what the series says.

name: DTK
description: The circle grid of DTK breathing over a mesh gradient, sealed with film grain. The order stays; air gets in.

cartela.eu:
Zenbaki bat gelaxka bakoitzeko, eta atalase bat. Ez dago beste erabakirik.
Sareta ez da marrazten: irakurri egiten da.
cartela.en:
One number per cell, and a threshold. There is no other decision.
The grid is not drawn: it is read.

name: BZRS
description: Hundreds of Bézier curves, each one a gradient between two colours of the palette. A single gesture repeated until it becomes fabric.

name: DTKRT
description: One lattice read twice. A boolean mask decides which cells hold a circle; a region grown cell by cell decides which of them share a ground. The block does not decorate — it reframes: the same circle means one thing on the field and another inside the region.

cartela.eu:
Hazi bat, eta ondokoetara hedatzea. Ez dago forma-katalogorik.
Barrak, eleak eta eskailerak arauaren ondorio dira, ez marrazki bat.
cartela.en:
A seed cell, then spread to its neighbours. There is no catalogue of shapes.
Bars, ells and staircases are consequences of the rule, not a drawing.

name: ECLPS
description: A single row of circles on one axis. The step between centres never changes; what changes is which of them are drawn. The grid stays perfect — the irregularity is all absence.

cartela.es:
El paso entre centros no cambia nunca. Lo que cambia es cuál de los círculos se calla.
La retícula no se rompe: el ritmo está hecho de ausencias.
cartela.en:
The step between centres never changes. What changes is which circle falls silent.
The lattice never breaks: the rhythm is made of absences.

name: TRZS
description: One continuous ribbon crosses the frame again and again; coming back in, it meets what it already wrote. Depth is not the order of drawing: it is settled crossing by crossing, over and under in turn, the way a knot diagram is read. What parts the strands is not an outline but an incision — the cut where the ground shows through.

cartela.eu:
Gainetik eta azpitik ez dira bi geruza: ibilbideari jarraituz txandakatzen dira.
Gurutzagune bakoitzetik bi aldiz igarotzen da, eta bigarrenak lehenaren kontrakoa dio.
cartela.en:
Over and under are not two layers: they alternate as the line is walked.
Every crossing is passed twice, and the second pass says the opposite of the first.

name: EVOL
description: Two bodies meet and weld. There is no over and no under, no incision: one single mass. And the ground, which in the crossing passed between, is here trapped — it survives only where the mass closes around it. It stops being a line and becomes an island with an edge. That is an eye, and the eyes are the work: the void is not what is left over, it is what the mass is there to define.

cartela.eu:
Bi gorputz elkartu eta bat egiten dute: ez dago gainetik, ez azpitik.
Lurra masak inguratzen duen tokian bakarrik bizirik: hutsunea ez da soberakina, mugatzeko dagoena baizik.
cartela.en:
Two bodies meet and weld: there is no over and no under.
The ground survives only where the mass closes around it — the void is not what is left over, it is what is there to be bounded.

name: PTZD
description: A block that tends to a square without being one, broken by cuts of a single constant width. They enter at an edge, branch, and die against one another — never crossing, so the white is a tree and not a lattice. The plates they release move aside, because the cut inserts space instead of removing matter. Nobody draws the outline: it is what survives the breaking.

cartela.es:
El corte no quita materia: mete espacio. Por eso las placas se apartan.
Y por eso la silueta no la traza nadie — es lo que queda cuando el bloque ha dejado de ser uno.
cartela.en:
The cut does not remove matter: it inserts space. That is why the plates move apart.
And why nobody draws the outline — it is what is left when the block has stopped being one.
